phase4_1_report:
Shadow review of PR #2014 (issue #2011 — rebalance modules-rest/modules-large CI shards).

No shard added or removed; union of module ids unchanged.

Post-change groups: modules-large=9, modules-rest=10, modules-pin=1 => 20 modules, matching the registry with no duplicates. The #877 union/no-duplicate/order/driver assertions in lib/test/run.sh remain satisfied (they are membership-agnostic between the two edited groups).

Phase 3 roster (5 dispatched, 5 returned):
- code-reviewer: Minor finding — AC3/AC4 description evidence missing; code itself clean.
- silent-failure-hunter: no findings — pure intra-partition token move; no silent drop/double-run/silent-error path affected.
- comment-analyzer: no findings — no coupled comment (union comment, ORDER coupled-invariant note, tier headers) rots under the rebalance.
- pr-test-analyzer: no findings — existing #877 assertions fully protect union/dup/order; the soft time-balance AC is correctly a recorded measurement, not a suite assertion.
- requesting-code-review (final pass): Medium finding — PR description lacks duration evidence; AC3 UNMET, AC4 UNESTABLISHED. Code change APPROVE-leaning.

AC verification: AC1 SATISFIED, AC2 SATISFIED, AC3 UNMET (WIP stub, no durations/source-run/assignment), AC4 UNMET/UNESTABLISHED (no recorded durations to compute the <=30s balance).

Verdict: REJECT — code is sound, but two acceptance criteria bound to the PR description are currently unsatisfied.

phase3_findings.description: PR #2014 description is still the WIP implement stub and carries none of the AC3/AC4 evidence: no measured per-module duration for the pre-change modules-rest/modules-large modules, no named source run, no stated resulting assignment, and no demonstration that the post-change estimated shard totals differ by <=30s. AC3 is UNMET and AC4 is UNESTABLISHED at reviewed head 80f58aba9. Not a code defect; blocks verifying the moved set is the one the measurements select.

AC3/AC4 require the PR description to record per-module measured durations, the source run, the resulting assignment, and the <=30s balance. The PR body is the WIP placeholder, so the rebalancing rationale (that this specific 4-module set is the one the measurements select and the totals are within 30s) is unverifiable. Evidentiary, not a code defect; discharged if the description is populated before merge.
